panels.title: Drop IN subscription price to ₹99/month
panels.scene: A medieval town square. Villagers are throwing money into the air and dancing. A merchant is weeping with joy. The knight stands to the side, unimpressed.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The king lowered the price! We can all afford to read scrolls now!

panels.title: Reject birthdates 18+ and pre-1926
panels.scene: A courtroom scene. An elderly villager with a cane is being dragged away by guards, protesting. A baby is similarly escorted away.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: But I was born in 1900! I demand to sign up!

bubbles.speaker: Guard
bubbles.text: Sorry sir, the Knight fixed the age validation. No ancient scrolls for you.

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: The form now uses a date range.

panels.title: Stop duplicate trials per user
panels.scene: A massive pile of gold coins is collapsing. The knight stands in front of it, holding a single coin. Villagers are panicking.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The great gold glitch is over! No more infinite trials!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Fixed credit accumulation with a database constraint.

panels.title: 13 commits. Trials fixed. Prices lowered. Ages validated.
panels.scene: The knight sits on a crate, polishing his sword, looking tired. In the background, villagers are building a statue of a calendar with '1926' prominently displayed. A merchant is handing out free scrolls.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: Let us celebrate the year of reasonable birthdates!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I also removed some obsolete documentation.
